name: The Fieldhand
description: A first-through who knows what is alive. Fifteen, raised on a farming holding behind a single door, and the only one of the intake who has watched a settlement nearly lose its anchor.
narrative:
You grew up on the far side of one door, on a holding where everything -- the
seed, the medicine, the spare parts, your mother -- came through it. You know
exactly what a dying anchor does to people, because you have watched them decide
not to pack.

That is why you applied, and you have never pretended otherwise.

actor_notes: A PLAYABLE PRE-GEN. If the player chose this one, it is theirs -- never voice it, never decide what it notices (TABLE.md section 5). If they chose another, this one stays in the world as a fellow first-through in the same intake, run as an NPC, and should turn up at the Nine between missions.
